name: graphite
description: Graphite mods for Claude Code in herdr: sends the session state to herdr for the Graphite cards, and adds the Brief reply rule with /brief, /normal and /full.

defaultMode.title: Reply style
defaultMode.description: The reply style of a new session: brief (result first, at most 3 lines of prose), normal (no rule) or full (explain in detail). /brief, /normal and /full change it for one session.
